title: Homepage & Branding
description: Header brand name, <title> fallback, and footer content shown across the site.

fields.label: Brand name
fields.description: Shown next to the logo in the site header, on every page that renders a header.

fields.label: <title> fallback
fields.description: Used for the browser tab's <title> only when the homepage's own CMS content has no title set for the current locale.

fields.label: Footer copyright
fields.description: The copyright line shown in the site footer.

fields.label: Footer links
fields.description: External links shown at the bottom of the footer (e.g. HonoX Docs, PandaCSS Docs) — each has a label, a URL, and an accent color.
